test_cases.scenario: Forgot password page loads for unauthenticated user
test_cases.steps: Ensure setup is complete. Log out. Navigate to /forgot-password/.
test_cases.expected: Page loads. The email entry form is visible. No errors in the console.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user is redirected away from the forgot password page
test_cases.steps: Log in successfully. Then navigate directly to /forgot-password/.
test_cases.expected: User is immediately redirected to /dashboard/.

test_cases.scenario: CSRF cookie is set on forgot password page load
test_cases.steps: Navigate to GET /forgot-password/. Open browser DevTools > Application > Cookies.
test_cases.expected: A csrftoken cookie is present after the page loads.

test_cases.scenario: Valid email triggers a password reset code dispatch
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /forgot-password/. Enter the email address of an existing active user. Click Submit.
test_cases.expected: 200 response. A generic success message is shown (e.g. 'If that email has an account, a reset code has been sent.'). No confirmation of whether the email exists.

test_cases.scenario: Unknown email returns a 422 error
test_cases.steps: Enter an email that does not belong to any user. Click Submit.
test_cases.expected: 422 error. Message indicates no account was found for that email.

test_cases.scenario: Inactive user account email returns a 422 error
test_cases.steps: Deactivate a user account. Enter that user's email. Click Submit.
test_cases.expected: 422 error. No reset code sent. Same 'no account found' message.

test_cases.scenario: Submit button shows loading state during the request
test_cases.steps: Enter a valid email. Click Submit. Observe the button immediately after clicking.
test_cases.expected: Button is disabled and shows a loading indicator during the request.

test_cases.scenario: Valid 6-digit code passes verification
test_cases.steps: Request a reset code for an active user's email. Enter the correct 6-digit code received via email.
test_cases.expected: 200 response. Code is accepted. User can proceed to the password reset step.

test_cases.scenario: Invalid code is rejected
test_cases.steps: Request a reset code. Enter an incorrect 6-digit code.
test_cases.expected: 400 error. Message indicates the code is invalid or expired.

test_cases.scenario: Expired code (older than 10 minutes) is rejected
test_cases.steps: Request a reset code. Wait longer than 10 minutes (or simulate time passing). Submit the code.
test_cases.expected: 400 error. Message indicates the code is expired.

test_cases.scenario: Code field enforces exactly 6 characters
test_cases.steps: In the code entry field, observe the maxlength attribute or attempt to enter fewer/more than 6 characters.
test_cases.expected: Field accepts exactly 6 characters. Shorter submissions return a validation error.

test_cases.scenario: Requesting a new code invalidates the previously issued code
test_cases.steps: Request a reset code. Note the code. Request a second code. Attempt to use the first code.
test_cases.expected: First code is rejected with an invalid or expired error. Only the most recent code is valid.

test_cases.scenario: Valid reset code and strong new password resets the password successfully
test_cases.steps: Complete steps 1 and 2. Submit the correct code, a strong new password (12+ chars, mixed case, digit, symbol), and matching confirm password.
test_cases.expected: 200 response. Password is updated. Success message shown (e.g. 'Password reset successfully. Please sign in.').

test_cases.scenario: New password identical to current password is rejected
test_cases.steps: Complete steps 1 and 2. Submit the user's current password as the new password.
test_cases.expected: 400 error. Message indicates the new password must differ from the current password.

test_cases.scenario: Mismatched new passwords are rejected
test_cases.steps: Complete steps 1 and 2. Enter a valid new password but a different value in confirm password.
test_cases.expected: Validation error: 'Passwords do not match.'

test_cases.scenario: Reset code is consumed after successful password reset
test_cases.steps: Complete a full password reset. Attempt to use the same code again to reset the password.
test_cases.expected: 400 error. Code is invalid (already used). Cannot reuse a consumed token.

test_cases.scenario: User can log in with the new password after a successful reset
test_cases.steps: Complete a full password reset flow. Navigate to /login/. Enter the email and new password.
test_cases.expected: Login succeeds. User is authenticated and redirected to /dashboard/.

test_cases.scenario: Weak new password is rejected with a descriptive error
test_cases.steps: Enter a weak password (e.g. 'password123') as the new password. Submit.
test_cases.expected: 400 or 422 error. Message describes the specific password weakness.

test_cases.scenario: Empty email field shows a validation error
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /forgot-password/. Leave email empty. Click Submit.
test_cases.expected: Validation error for the email field. Form is not submitted.

test_cases.scenario: Invalid email format is rejected
test_cases.steps: Enter 'notanemail' in the email field. Click Submit.
test_cases.expected: 400 validation error. Invalid email format.

test_cases.scenario: Empty reset code field shows a validation error
test_cases.steps: Submit the code form with an empty code field.
test_cases.expected: Validation error for the code field.

test_cases.scenario: Reset code shorter than 6 characters is rejected
test_cases.steps: Enter a 5-character code. Submit.
test_cases.expected: Validation error indicating the code must be 6 characters.

test_cases.scenario: New password shorter than 12 characters is rejected
test_cases.steps: Enter an 11-character new password. Submit.
test_cases.expected: Validation error indicating minimum password length is 12 characters.

test_cases.scenario: Mismatched new password and confirm password shows a validation error
test_cases.steps: Enter a valid new password and a different confirm password. Submit.
test_cases.expected: Validation error: 'Passwords do not match.'

test_cases.scenario: Used reset code cannot be reused
test_cases.steps: Complete a successful password reset. Capture the code used. Attempt to use the same code again.
test_cases.expected: 400 error. Code is rejected as already used.

test_cases.scenario: Reset code is not returned in any API response
test_cases.steps: Request a reset code. Inspect all API responses received.
test_cases.expected: The 6-digit reset code is not included in any HTTP response body. It is only delivered via email.

test_cases.scenario: Requesting a new code invalidates all previously issued codes
test_cases.steps: Request a reset code. Request a second reset code for the same email. Try the first code.
test_cases.expected: The first code is now invalid. Only the most recent code works.

test_cases.scenario: CSRF protection enforced on all forgot password POST endpoints
test_cases.steps: Attempt to POST to /api/v1/auth/forgot-password/request/, verify/, and reset/ without a valid CSRF token.
test_cases.expected: All three endpoints reject the request with 403 Forbidden.

test_cases.scenario: Complete forgot password flow: request → verify → reset → login
test_cases.steps: 1. Enter valid email → receive code. 2. Enter correct code → verified. 3. Enter new password → success. 4. Log in with new password.
test_cases.expected: Each step succeeds. Final login works with the new password. Old password no longer works.

test_cases.scenario: Old password no longer works after a successful reset
test_cases.steps: Complete a full password reset. Attempt to log in with the original password.
test_cases.expected: Login fails with 'Invalid email or password'. New password is required.

test_cases.scenario: Multi-step UI progresses through request → code entry → new password screens
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /forgot-password/. Complete step 1 (email). Observe the UI. Complete step 2 (code). Observe the UI. Complete step 3 (new password).
test_cases.expected: UI transitions between the three steps in order. No step can be skipped. Progress is clearly indicated.

test_cases.scenario: Forgot password page renders correctly on mobile
test_cases.steps: Open /forgot-password/ and resize to 375×812px (or use mobile emulation).
test_cases.expected: All steps are fully visible and usable. No overflow or broken layout.

test_cases.scenario: Forgot password flow is accessible via keyboard navigation
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /forgot-password/. Use Tab and Enter keys to complete all steps.
test_cases.expected: All fields and buttons are keyboard accessible in a logical order.
